title: Implement native rendered-region Tesseract reader
worker: zcode-t27 (ZCode app, single active ZCode worker)
review_scope: implementation_commit 394e65c07be89e2a867b0b316fe46940f927dbf9 plus evidence commits on this branch

executed_commands.command: uv run --project native python -m pytest native/tests/ocr -q
uv run --project native python -m pytest native/tests -q

deliverables.native/inkflip/readers/tesseract.py: rendered-region OCR adapter: fixed argv, shell=False, neutral private filenames, validated language identifiers, local model hashing, padded-crop planning with recorded inverse transforms, verbatim raw words with diagnostic confidence, distinct typed failure terminals
deliverables.native/tests/ocr/test_ocr.py: TEST-27 suite: 20 tests over real tesseract 5.5.3 runs on T05 fixture renders (F01 amount line, F03 scan pixel-only independence, F08 UserUnit render compensation, failure-mode matrix, option-injection defense, schema conformance)

measured_decisions.decision: Native full-page default PSM 3 instead of the browser PSM 6 prescription
measured_decisions.reason: Measured: PSM 6 drops the isolated '$100' amount line on the F01 render; PSM 3/11 find it. PSM is recorded per invocation (raw_source_locator tag); single-line user regions use PSM 7 as the contract requires.

measured_decisions.decision: Canonical geometry only with recorded raster scale; otherwise 'unknown' with null polygon
measured_decisions.reason: COORDINATES.md requires explicit transform chains; guessing geometry from pixels without the recorded named-render metadata would violate I04.

review_attention: F03 OCR intentionally misreads the 5x7 bitmap print ('2026-0417' -> '2626-6417'); the tests assert raw retention and pixel-only independence (identical word sequences for scan-correct vs scan-raster-only), not recognition accuracy.
Timeout kills the tesseract child only; process-group supervision, two-message backpressure and atomic partial results are T29 scope (recorded in limitations and dependency requests).
limitations: Printed English OCR only; no non-Latin script recognition is claimed (F14 preservation stays with native text readers).
No Linux execution claimed; native reference environment parity is T46 scope.
dependency_requests: Fixture owner lane: committed F14/F15 families when assigned.
T29: wrap with parent/child supervision and partial-result atomicity.
attribution: No external material reused; adapter implements the project's own contract against the locally installed Tesseract and frozen dependencies.
state_note: Worker does not write Beads; coordinator is the sole state owner. Requested transition on review approval: in_review -> accepted after merged-branch acceptance per docs/ACCEPTANCE.md.
